blocks.explanation:
Yeh "show that" ka sawal hai: jawab pehle se diya hua hai, humein raasta dikhana hai.
Diya kya hai? Circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 25\).
Saabit kya karna hai? \(y^{3}y_{2} + 25 = 0\).
Rule kaunsa? Implicit differentiation aur quotient rule.
Plan: \(y_{1} = -\frac{x}{y}\), phir \(y_{2}\), aur aakhir mein \(x^{2} + y^{2}\) ki jagah 25.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 25\) ...(1).
Saabit karna: \(y^{3}\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} + 25 = 0\).
Tareeqa: implicit differentiation do dafa. Result mein 25 hai, to andaza lagaiye: kahin \(x^{2} + y^{2}\) nikal kar aayega jise 25 se badalna hoga.

Pehla derivative
\[2x + 2y\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 0\]
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -\dfrac{x}{y} \quad \text{...(2)}\]
Kyun: \(y\) \(x\) ka function hai, to \(\frac{d}{dx}y^{2} = 2y\frac{dy}{dx}\); constant 25 ka derivative 0. Phir 2 cancel aur \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) akela.

Doosra derivative
\[\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} = -\dfrac{y\cdot 1 - x\frac{dy}{dx}}{y^{2}}\]
\[= -\dfrac{y + \frac{x^{2}}{y}}{y^{2}}\]
\[= -\dfrac{x^{2} + y^{2}}{y^{3}}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{x}{y}\) par quotient rule (minus bahar rakha). (2) se \(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{x}{y}\) rakha, to \(-x\cdot\left(-\frac{x}{y}\right) = +\frac{x^{2}}{y}\). Phir upar neeche \(y\) se multiply kiya.
Dhyan dein: \(y\) ka derivative 1 likhna (yani \(y\) ko \(x\) samajhna) yahan sab se aam ghalti hai.

(1) istemal karein
\[\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} = -\dfrac{25}{y^{3}}\]
\[y^{3}\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} = -25\]
\[y^{3}\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} + 25 = 0\]
Kyun: (1) ke mutabiq \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 25\); phir dono taraf \(y^{3}\) se multiply kar ke 25 left par le aaye.

Tasdeeq
Circle ke sab se oonche point \((0, 5)\) par: \(y = \sqrt{25 - x^{2}}\) ka second derivative \(x = 0\) par \(-\frac{1}{5}\) hai, aur \(125 \times \left(-\frac{1}{5}\right) + 25 = -25 + 25 = 0\). Result sahi hai.
